record.programme: M.Sc. Data Science and Artificial Intelligence

degree_requirement.value: Bachelor's degree from a German university (at least 180 CP) or an equivalent qualification from a foreign university in computer science, informatics or a related field
degree_requirement.quote: Bachelor's degree from a German university (at least 180 CP) or an equivalent qualification from a foreign university in computer science, informatics or a related field

min_total_ects.quote: Bachelor's degree from a German university (at least 180 CP) or an equivalent qualification from a foreign university in computer science, informatics or a related field

english.quote: The following certificates will be accepted: _ IELTS (academic test): min. 7.0 out of 9 _ TOEFL (internet based): min. 95 out of 120 (2026: 5 out of 6) _ TOEFL (paper based): min. 600 out of 677 (2026: 5 out of 6) _ Cambridge English Certificate: C1 Advanced (CAE) or C2 Proficiency (CPE) _ PTE Academic: min. 76

entrance_tests.quote: Applicants for Computer Science, Cybersecurity, DSAI, Embedded Systems and Visual Computing who have no degree certificate earned within the European Higher Education Area (EHEA) region, Switzerland, or the UK are required to upload the test result from the GRE General Test or the Indian GATE test .

german.quote: Knowledge of proficiency in German is not required.

aps_required.quote: Applicants who have obtained their university degree in China, India or Vietnam are required to submit the original ( digitally signed ) APS Certificate issued by the Academic Evaluation Center (Akademische Prüfstelle) in the corresponding country with the application.

application_route.quote: Applications should be submitted via the online application portal managed by the Department of Computer Science.

deadlines.quote: Applications should normally be received by 15 May for students seeking to begin studying in the winter semester and by 15 November for students looking to start their studies in summer.

selection_process.value: The criteria listed above will be used to assess the aptitude of the applicant in terms of the academic profile and requirements of the respective Master’s degree programme. The decision whether the programme admission requirements have been met is made by the Examination Board.

value: a copy of your university entrance qualification
copies of your 3 most recent degrees* (with certified translation, if the original language is not English, German or French)
a certified list of all attended courses with the respective grades, including an explanation of the grading system
Curriculum Vitae (CV) including information on your areas of interest in research, as well as any projects or publications
two complete review forms by recommenders appointed by the applicant
APS Certificate (for applicants with degrees from China, India or Vietnam)
GRE General Test or Indian GATE test result (for applicants with degrees from outside EHEA, Switzerland, or the UK)
